page_title: FUL 0-1 WHU | Fulham v West Ham 04/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+10' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+9' Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
90+5' Matthew Donohue blows his whistle. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) has replaced Mateus Fernandes.
90+2' Here is a change. Jean-Clair Todibo is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
90+1' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Matthew Donohue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Taty Castellanos did his best and is replaced by Adama Traore (West Ham).

88' Mads Hermansen makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Timothy Castagne (Fulham) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
86' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Timothy Castagne (Fulham), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
84' Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
84' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
82' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Sander Berge will be replaced by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is coming onto the pitch as Kenny Tete cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

78' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
76' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
76' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
73' 9:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
70' West Ham couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
68' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

65' 0 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen slips a clever pass through to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

65' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom right corner. His promising effort is kept out by Mads Hermansen, who pulls off a stunning save!
64' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) for Joshua King.
61' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Oscar Bobb (Fulham) replaces Tom Cairney.
60' That will be all from Callum Wilson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham).
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Raul Jimenez will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).

60' Callum Wilson (West Ham) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
56' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
54' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by West Ham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' The referee blows his whistle as Raul Jimenez (Fulham) was too aggressive in his challenge. West Ham win a free kick.
50' Referee Matthew Donohue reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
49' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Fulham as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

49' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Fulham is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
47' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

46' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Joshua King (Fulham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Mads Hermansen.
45+2' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.

45+1' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) jumps into a tackle and Matthew Donohue signals a foul. Fulham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
44' Close! Callum Wilson (West Ham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
43' West Ham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
39' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
37' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
35' West Ham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

33' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
30' Tom Cairney (Fulham) makes a strong challenge and Matthew Donohue blows for a foul.
28' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
27' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
26' Joshua King (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
24' A pass from El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
23' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
22' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' Axel Disasi (West Ham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Matthew Donohue shows a yellow card to Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
16' That looked a certain handball by Calvin Bassey (Fulham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
16' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. West Ham earn a corner.
15' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
13' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
11' West Ham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
9' Joshua King (Fulham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
7' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Kenny Tete (Fulham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

4' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mads Hermansen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

1' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Bernd Leno shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fulham will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Matthew Donohue.
